description: A small pill that shows a status or category: "Lunas", "Menunggu Bayar", "Premium".

guidelines.text: Always include text — never rely on color alone.
guidelines.contrast: Status text uses a darker shade than the dot so the contrast meets WCAG AA.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: The seven tones from DESIGN.md (success, warning, danger, info, neutral, brand, premium) plus outline.

withoutDot.title: Without Dot / With Icon
withoutDot.description: dot={false} removes the dot, for example when the badge contains an icon.

asLink.title: As Link
asLink.description: asChild applies the badge styles to the child element, such as an <a>.

props.dot: Show a 6px dot before the text.
props.asChild: Apply the styles to the child element (no dot is added).
